subject: Web Development
title: The Critical Rendering Path
description: A fast breakdown of The Critical Rendering Path for builders.

hook.text: Between typing a URL and seeing pixels, the browser follows a strict sequence of steps.

buildup.text: Build the DOM, build the style tree, create the render tree, calculate layout, then paint.

discovery.text: This sequence is the critical rendering path. Every web page goes through it.

twist.text: Blocking resources like CSS and JS can stall the path, delaying the first visible paint.

climax.text: Optimizing this path is the single biggest lever for making websites feel fast.

punchline.text: Faster paths mean faster first impressions.

quiz.question: What is the critical rendering path?
